name: Surgeon at Gare Porto
description: For techno fans, legendary British DJ Surgeon takes over the decks at one of Porto's premier electronic music venues.
longDescription:
On April 25, 2026, British DJ and producer Surgeon, also known as Anthony Child, will perform a live set at Gare Porto. Child is a prominent figure in the techno scene, known for his experimental approach and influential releases on labels such as Downwards and Tresor. His career spans several decades, establishing him as a significant artist within electronic music.

Attendees can expect an evening focused on techno music within the industrial-chic setting of Gare Porto. The venue, located in the city's Campanhã district, is recognized for its sound system and atmosphere conducive to electronic music events. The event is primarily aimed at adults with an interest in techno and club culture.

Tickets for the event are priced variably and can be purchased in advance. Gare Porto is accessible via public transport; it is a short walk from Campanhã metro and train station, which serves multiple lines and regional connections.
